text:
sam: @channel prepping a preflight for the new org 'orion' (AWS + GCP) — goal is to have enrollable projects in both clouds with GPU capacity and proper tagging/billing before we hand to platform teams. Need quick eyes on quotas, networking, IAM and cost tagging.

jill: ack — I'll take GCP quotas and project bootstrap. Target regions?

andre: AWS ok from me. prefer us-west-2 + eu-west-1 for now. we'll need ENI and ENA limits checked.

maria: security notes: CMEK for all customer projects, org policy to prevent public VM IPs, and log sink to a restricted project. Also requires KMS permissions in billing account.

sam: rough checklist I'm proposing (short):
- org + billing account created
- dedicated billing project + budget alerts
- projects: infra-gke, infra-ml, infra-data (per-cloud)
- IAM: org-level roles, SA templates, workload identity mapping (GCP)
- VPCs: shared VPCs, subnets scoped to region, NAT gateways, no public node IPs
- quotas: GPU (A100/4x, T4/16x), CPUs, GPUs per region, IP addresses, ENIs, egress NAT throughput
- tags: cost_center, product, environment, owner_email
- org policies: restrict external IPs, disable legacy oauth clients, require CMEK
- monitoring: export logs + VPC flow logs to central project

jill: for GCP quota requests: we should request both 'Accelerator (a100)' and 'GPUs (overall)'. Use the GCP quota request form but include project id and expected sustained qps. Example text I paste in request: 
```
Project: orion-infra-gcp
Region: europe-west4
Quota increase: 8 A100 GPUs (a100-80g) initially, request to allow burst to 16
Reason: production inference cluster for Redwood internal playground, estimated sustained 800 tps per cluster
ETA: 2-3 weeks
Contact: jill@redwood.com
```
Also request IP address quota in the same region (we use shared VPC so small number of external IPs).

andre: AWS service quotas to request: 
- EC2: G4dn/G5/G5g or p4? we want p4d if available but may be hard in eu-west-1. Request increase on "Running On-Demand instances (P4)" + Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) + EBS throughput.
- EC2-Classic not relevant. Also request EC2 instance limits per AZ, and increase EIP quota if we need public IPs.
Sample AWS support body: 
```
Account: 123456789012
Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1
Quota: Increase Running On-Demand P4d instances to 8 in us-west-2, 2 in eu-west-1
Also increase EC2 ENI limit to 200 in us-west-2
Reason: Dedicated inference fleet for Redwood customers, project orion-infra-aws
Contact: andre@redwood.com
```

maria: For security compliance, add these to requests: mention that all instances use private subnet + NAT, and keys are in KMS. If customer data will be processed, flag for SOC23 review early.

sam: Networking items:
- Reserve NAT capacity (NAT gateways or egress NAT IPs) for burst traffic — we saw tail latencies spike when NAT SNAT table exhausted.
- Request per-VPC Egress quota increase (GCP) and Cloud NAT ephemeral port quota.
- On AWS, request increased SNAT ports by adding NAT GW autoscaling + allocate additional EIPs.
- Check route limits on GKE clusters (max routes per VPC) and per-subnet IP availability.

jill: tip: when filing GCP quota ticket, attach sample deployment YAML with node pools and acceleratorConfig so support sees expected node/accelerator mix. It speeds approvals.

andre: also check marketplace/private AMI provisioning quotas if we'll spin images via SSM. That has its own service limits for concurrent installs.

sam: cost discussion quick note: reserved capacity vs on-demand. For initial onboard we'll do on-demand with autoscaling, then convert stable pools to reserved instances/dedicated capacity (AWS Savings Plan or committed use discounts on GCP). Add cost-center tag early so billing export maps cleanly.

maria: owners and next steps: 
- jill: open GCP quota form + request IP quota + example YAML (due EOD)
- andre: open AWS service quota case + ENI/EIP increases (due EOD)
- sam: create billing account + budgets + tag taxonomy doc (due tomorrow)
- maria: draft org policies and KMS plan, will sync with compliance (due tomorrow)

quota-bot: automated reminder: don't forget to add the ticket IDs back here once created.

sam: attaching a quick example GCP node pool snippet to include in the quota ticket:
```yaml
apiVersion: container.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1
kind: ContainerNodePool
metadata:
  name: inference-pool
spec:
  initialNodeCount: 4
  autoscaling:
    minNodeCount: 2
    maxNodeCount: 16
  nodeConfig:
    machineType: n1-standard-32
    accelerators:
    - acceleratorType: "nvidia-tesla-a100"
      acceleratorCount: 2
    diskSizeGb: 200
```

jill: perfect. I'll paste that in. Also: tag key names for GCP: cost_center, product, env, owner. For AWS make sure AWS Cost Allocation tags enabled in the account and IAM policy allows tag creation.

andre: FYI p4d availability is limited; consider fallback flavor g5. will add fallback plan in the ticket.

sam: final QA checklist before we submit ticket:
- [ ] billing account created and linked
- [ ] projects exist with correct names
- [ ] YAML + instance list included in request
- [ ] security notes (CMEK, private IPs) included
- [ ] cost tags documented
- [ ] owners assigned

maria: I'll review tickets after they're created to ensure compliance language is present.

sam: thanks all — please post the ticket IDs here once submitted. I'll run a quick smoke test once quotas come in (spin 1 node, validate GPU visibility + egress). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 on 2026-06-12 may affect capacity. Consider that when choosing fallback AZs.

sam: good catch deploy-bot — andre, factor that maintenance window into the AWS request.

andre: noted, will request extra capacity in eu-central-1 as a cross-check.

sam: closing for now, will reopen if any blocker.
